reason: Examined the t = -1 specialization U = (1,-1;0,1), V = (1,0;1,1); UVU = VUV = (0,-1;1,0) has order four, U^{-1} and UVU are the standard generators, and the Euclidean presentation <U,V | UVU = VUV, (UVU)^4 = 1> is SL_2(Z), so the kernel is the normal closure of Delta^4.
